work_packages.current_evidence_status: 2026-11-14: Independently reviewed original PyNEXUS annual config shows 52.5N,3.5E are offshore ERA5 weather-grid coordinates, NOT an industrial hydrogen delivery site. Hynetwork Exit Terms v2.0 p4 clause2.1.2 explicitly deny gas procurement/supply guarantee. Exit Annex12 p3 permits open-pipe or a separately agreed reduced customer exit pressure in the signed CDS; 30–50bar(g) network operating range cannot prove 20bar(a) customer node. Thus TWO independent agreements are required: actual network exit CDS/technical capacity AND merchant H2 molecules+shipper nomination/quality/firm supply. Original source-based 8760h F3 topup peak gross 1029.028kg/h (~40.462MW HHV using HNS CSA 12.74MJ/Nm3 and0.09kg/Nm3) or usable183.609kg/h (~7.220MW HHV); these are incremental source feasible-incumbent shortage flows NOT a customer's total booked exit capacity or physical supplier rating. F3 full matched service and v1 release NOT PASSED.
